note: Status of every stage and deliverable of the Phase VII request. 'executed' means run and its output stored; 'pilot' means run at reduced scope with the reason; 'not executed' and 'blocked' give the reason and, for blocked items, the closed list of actions that would unblock them. Nothing listed as not executed has an invented result file.

B DINO + MLP (mandatory).scope: L0-L11, L8p, L10p/L10r (post hoc), k 8/32 sensitivity, listwise loss for L2/L8, local LG/LD/LGD; 3 seeds; 5 grouped folds; 316 parts

C articulated simulation.scope: the cell's own six-axis arm, computed-torque control, planner joint values; 151 development parts x first grasps of 5 methods x 7 conditions; EGAD replication of M0/M1/Joint (descriptive)
C articulated simulation.not_done: calibrated industrial arm model, arm collision geometry, Cartesian lift, joint friction

D few-shot / DKL / ADKF-IFT.reason: With the learned order the first examined candidate is viable for 87 % of development parts; the mean number of extra candidates any adaptive model could save is 1.30 (about 5 ms of planner time) against a fixed planner cost of 0.57 s, before paying for its own support evaluations. A support set can only be obtained by evaluating candidates, i.e. by doing the planner's work.

D complementarity (FORTIS-MUL).reason: the multiplicative fusion family (M4, M9, Joint) is the complementarity analysis; no separate FORTIS-MUL experiment beyond Phase VI's grid

D cross-robot (40/120 mm).note: stroke variants of one cell, not other robots; unseen configurations only zero-shot from 80 mm

D multifidelity / cost-aware ordering.status: not executed as a separate method
D multifidelity / cost-aware ordering.reason: the per-candidate planner cost is nearly constant and the first-candidate hit rate is 87 %; the fallback (round robin) is the cost-aware safeguard studied. Planner stage timings are reported in the cost files.

E external baselines.executed: classical analytic ranking (force closure then wrench-space epsilon) at the ranking-controlled level on 40 development parts
